run.detail: Accept canonical owner_start_ns before preflight; normal_until=min(owner_start+95,caller_entry+100). No threading timer, Lock, caller killpg/direct signal or lingering cleanup. Native Popen inherits caller group; validate/record actual PGID before native reap. Bounded native-child poll/reap is permitted because outer retains the caller anchor. Caller stops/spawn refuses and preserves bounded partial receipts; resource-stop authority moves to sole outer sampler. New receipt distinguishes native direct reap from root group absence.

nested_function_dispositions.run_root_once.py/main.request: Retain latch-only signal handler meaning; use shared t0_ns and record both TERM/INT requests. No handler group signal or reap.

nested_function_dispositions.run_native_capture.py/run.stop: Remove lock/timer/group-kill function. No caller replacement stop controller; outer alone owns resource/timeout group signals.

global_initializer_and_entry_disposition: Owner imports time then captures earliest t0_ns before other imports; add select, retain SIGCHLD default and strong leader reference; replace monolithic sha lambda with bounded chunked equivalent.
Replace caller threading import/Timer/Lock/callback setup with single synchronous native direct-child observation and latch-only stop handling.
